claims.evidence: Witness saw multiple gears (chainrings/cassette) but could not count exact speeds.
Handlebars and grips seen but no shifter mechanism specifically identified in report.
Frame material cannot be determined from a photo; witness gave no material detail.
No way to assess performance from a static photo.
No purchase date, receipt, or wear-based age indicator visible.
Report explicitly lists brake and gear-shift function as not shown.
Report explicitly lists rust/corrosion on chain, spokes, frame as not shown.
No serial number or brand markings legible to confirm originality.

risks.risk: Frame material may not be aluminum (could be heavier steel, affecting value and handling)
risks.proof: Close-up of frame decal/sticker stating material, or magnet test video (magnet won't stick to aluminum)
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown/generic frame material, not premium aluminum

risks.risk: Gear shifting and brakes may not function smoothly despite claim
risks.proof: Short video cycling through all gears and applying front/rear brakes

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on chain, spokes, or frame joints
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain, spokes, and frame welds/joints in good light
risks.if_unproven: price as having visible wear/rust risk

risks.risk: Tire tread wear or hidden punctures/patches
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tire treads and sidewalls
risks.if_unproven: price as tires needing replacement soon

risks.proof: Photo of frame with a tape measure or stated seat-tube length

risks.risk: Obscured watermark could indicate counterfeit or unbranded frame, affecting resale value
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photo of the full brand decal/watermark
risks.if_unproven: price as unbranded/generic bicycle, no brand premium

risks.risk: Claimed 6-month age cannot be confirmed, bike could be older with more wear
risks.proof: Photo of original purchase receipt or box/warranty card
risks.if_unproven: price as used bicycle of unknown age

risks.risk: No serial number shown, cannot confirm it isn't stolen or swapped parts
risks.proof: Photo of serial number stamped on frame (usually under bottom bracket)
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified provenance, standard used-bike risk

proof_requests: Video of all 24 gear changes and both brakes being applied
Close-up photos of chain, spokes, frame joints, and both tire treads
Clear photo of frame brand/watermark decal and serial number
Photo of purchase receipt or original packaging if available
Photo of frame with tape measure for size reference
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a road/hybrid bicycle, so it can be priced, but seller's claims on speed count, material, age, and condition are unverified or unverifiable, so it must be priced at worst case (generic material, unconfirmed mechanical condition, possible wear) pending the listed proofs.
